text: Over the last 30 days, visitors have noted issues related to food quality and wait times at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Four reviews mentioned concerns with the food, and three highlighted wait times as an area needing attention. Service was also mentioned twice, while the atmosphere was noted once. Despite these points, all six reviews gave a five-star rating, and there were no critical comments.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was frequently backed up and only grab-and-go options were available late in the day. Many found the food quality inconsistent and portions small relative to the high prices. There were also complaints about the menu choices and preparation, with some items described as bland or poorly executed. Addressing these concerns around food quality, pricing, and service efficiency should be a priority.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited, overpriced, and the food quality below expectations, with several mentioning poor preparation and small portions. Service problems included long waits and inconsistent availability of menu items, leading to frustration. While the library itself received some positive comments, the cafe’s offerings and operations need attention to improve visitor satisfaction.
